description: A rainy outdoor fashion show on an airport apron at dusk. A young woman with short natural hair walks towards the camera down the wet runway in a black turtleneck, a very short flared orange skirt, black tights, knee-high black boots and a long black coat that swings as she moves. Guests sit on both sides, some under umbrellas, a large passenger plane stands behind them, floodlights and a lighting rig glow, confetti blows in the wind and a worker in a high-visibility jacket runs across under stormy orange clouds.
